title: KPN team events at #ASHG23
summary: The Knowledge Portal Network team will be attending the American Society of Human Genetics meeting next week and we hope to see you there!
bodyHtml:
The Knowledge Portal Network team will be attending the American Society of Human Genetics meeting next week and we hope to see you there! Attend our ancillary session to hear about the latest developments in the Knowledge Portals; come by our booth to say hello, give us feedback, or get a 1:1 tutorial; and stop by our poster on Saturday afternoon.

Find times and locations in the flyer below. You can see the full agenda for the ancillary session here.

Opening hours for the Exhibit & Poster Hall are:

Thursday, November 2: 9:30 am - 5:00 pm
Friday, November 3: 10:00 am - 5:00 pm
Saturday, November 4: 10:00 am - 4:30 pm
